entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
ORDER Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner files a memo, stating that for the time being, he is not pressing the petition, as the question of maintainability of the petition has been raised.
He submits that, he may be permitted to file appropriate petition at appropriate stage.
Hence, without expressing anything on the merits, the petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as sought for.
